alex: New model candidate landed: meta-llama-lite-3b-q4a (vendor drop). Can we triage quality + perf before we spin up Dedicated capacity?

maria: Thanks — what's the minimal eval plan/criteria?

alex: Quick plan: smoke evals only to decide pass/fail. Suites: chat-regression (100 prompts), instruction-follow (200), embeddings-sanity (1k pairs). Baseline = redwood-1.3 (prod). Pass rules: chat_winrate >= 0.90 vs baseline, embeddings cosine_avg >= 0.98 of baseline, instruction BLEU drop <= 1.5 points, hallucination spot-check <= 3% absolute. Also check p95 latency and memory at 10qps.

keenan: Add perf gate: p95 token latency < 200ms on our small GPU profile at qps 10. If quant version helps perf but harms quality, we need explicit sign-off.

sophie: For quant experiments, run FP16, q8_0, q4a. Also do runs with prefix-caching on/off to check KV cache interaction.

alex: Kicking off eval harness now. Command I'll use:```
./eval_harness/run.sh --model meta-llama-lite-3b-q4a --suites chat-regression,instruction,embeddings --seed 42 --parallel 8 --output /tmp/ll-eval.json
```

eval-bot: Eval job 1834567901 started on k8s-job-ml-eval-412 :rocket:

maria: Please add a tiny legal/compliance prompt set (10 prompts) — we need to flag Private deployment risk early.

keenan: When results land, post a 1-line verdict + table. If any metric regresses >5% absolute, mark as 'stop' immediately.

sophie: Also schedule a qualitative sample: 50 random chats reviewed by @maria and @alex. Label for hallucination/tone/regression.

alex: Will run baseline + candidate, then post short summary and attach /tmp/ll-eval.json.

eval-bot: Job 1834568200 finished. Summary: chat_winrate=0.88, emb_cos_avg=0.992, instr_bleu_delta=-0.8, hallucination_rate=4.2%, p95_latency=185ms (q4a)

maria: chat_winrate 0.88 < 0.90 threshold -> FAIL on chat. Hallucination 4.2% > 3% -> FAIL. Embeddings look fine. Need triage notes before any canary.

alex: Quick triage: observed softer follow-up completions and occasional evasive answers in clarifying prompts. Looks like quantization shifted token selection distribution for some prompts. I'll run q8_0 and FP16 to isolate.

keenan: Tag this candidate DONT_SERVE for hosted API for now. Create a ticket for detailed diffs and attach examples.

sophie: Created ML-8702 with links to /tmp/ll-eval.json and sample outputs. Assigning labelers for the 50-chat review.

alex: Re-run plan: fp16, q8_0, and a q4a run with prefix-caching disabled. If any variant meets chat_winrate >= 0.90 and hallucination <= 3% we can consider a limited canary (1% traffic) on Dedicated.

maria: Agree. Also let's update the gating doc to include both absolute fail thresholds and relative-delta rules; I'll open a PR with suggested numbers after the qualitative pass. :thumbsup:

sophie: I'll finish annotations today (ETA EOD) and post the label summary.

alex: Thanks — moving thread to triage. Will post re-runs and a one-line final verdict here before EOD. :eyes:
